Proof: `npx tsx tests/metrics-canonical.mts` with a fixture that INCLUDES the trap case (local ledger status:'sent' + linked OutreachMessage.dryRun:true + a synthetic candidate) and asserts both are EXCLUDED, plus HUD/metrics agreement.

Proof: `npx tsx tests/databricks-intake.mts` — stubbed fetch proving SSRF rejection of a private host, auth header, parameterization, JSON_ARRAY mapping incl. malformed-row rejection, PENDING→poll, and that no state mutation/campaign creation happens server-side.

item.text: A material issue remains in W1: `dryRun === false` is a necessary discriminator, but it is not itself a send fact. In live mode, approvals set `dryRun:false` before any real send happens, with `sentAt:null`, so v2 can still overcount pending approvals as contacted unless the definition includes an actual sent/provider-accepted terminal fact.

item.text:
blocker: W1 — `OutreachMessage.dryRun === false` is only the demo/simulation discriminator, not a real send fact; live approval sets `dryRun:false` while `sentAt:null` and ledger status is only `claimed`/`pending_manual`, so W1 must define real contacted as `dryRun === false AND sentAt != null` for local outreach or a provider/server ledger terminal `status:'sent'`, otherwise pending live approvals count as contacted (PLAN-wave2.md:20, ../src/lib/store.ts:2537, ../src/lib/store.ts:2550, ../src/lib/store.ts:2560, ../src/lib/store.ts:2561, ../src/app/api/outreach/send/route.ts:410).

blocker: W2/W3 — because W2 touchCount and W3 tiles consume W1, “real, non-dryRun touches” still overcounts unsent live approvals unless W1’s send fact includes `sentAt`/provider `sent`; manual LinkedIn confirm and delivered provider sends are the actual local transition points to count (PLAN-wave2.md:21, PLAN-wave2.md:22, ../src/lib/store.ts:2660, ../src/lib/store.ts:2685, ../src/lib/store.ts:2813, ../src/lib/store.ts:2817, ../src/lib/store.ts:2821).

risk: W1 proof — the trap fixture now excludes dry-run sent plus synthetic, but it also needs a live approved unsent fixture (`dryRun:false`, `sentAt:null`, ledger `claimed`) and must assert exclusion; that is the remaining false-positive case in the current plan (PLAN-wave2.md:20, ../src/lib/store.ts:2541, ../src/lib/store.ts:2557, ../src/lib/store.ts:2560).

nit: W4 — Databricks v2 is sound and buildable: dedicated `DatabricksSettings`, api key only for the secret, `assertPublicUrl`, private-link out of scope, proposed drafts only, and no server mutation proof cover the round-1 blockers (PLAN-wave2.md:23).

nit: W2/W3 — privacy, cap, RBAC, demo bannering, synthetic exclusion, test filenames, and order are otherwise resolved enough to build once W1’s real-send predicate is tightened (PLAN-wave2.md:21, PLAN-wave2.md:22, PLAN-wave2.md:24, PLAN-wave2.md:26).
